Name: DecisionCS
Title: Medication Administration Decision Codes
Description: Local codes for the nurse's decision following contraindication assessment in ONCO home-hospitalization questionnaires.

Name: SpirometryComponentCS
Title: Spirometry Component Codes
Description: Local codes for spirometry session quality components that have no LOINC or SNOMED CT equivalent. Used as `Observation.component.code` in the Spirometry Observation profile.

Name: SpirometryGradeCS
Title: Spirometry Grade Codes (ATS/ERS 2019)
Description: Session-level quality grades for FEV1 and FVC as defined in Table 10 of the ATS/ERS 2019 technical standard (Graham BL et al., Standardization of Spirometry 2019 Update, Am J Respir Crit Care Med 2019;200(8):e70-e88). The repeatability thresholds below apply to patients older than 6 years. FEV1 and FVC are graded independently.
